description: A clock generator sending a 1ms trigger at a rate you set, with a choice of four divisions

params.text: Sets the underlying tick rate on an exponential scale, 0.1Hz to 20Hz
Sends one trigger for every 1, 2, 4 or 8 underlying ticks

inputs.text: Restarts the count on a rising edge, sending a trigger at once and putting the division back to its first tick, reading high above 1V and low below 0V

notes: the clock runs from the moment the module is placed; there is no start switch and no way to stop it short of bypassing the module

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
